blocks.md: **Every node = a parent with up to two children. Every tree question is answered by asking ALL SUBTREES the same tiny question — recursion mantra incarnate.**

blocks.label: the node + manual build
blocks.py:
class TreeNode:
    def __init__(self, val):
        self.val = val
        self.left = None
        self.right = None

root = TreeNode(1)
root.left = TreeNode(2)
root.right = TreeNode(3)

blocks.title: Trace: inorder L,N,R on tree 1( left:2 , right:3 ) with 2 having right child 5

blocks.md: Three famous orders differ ONLY in WHEN the parent is announced relative to its two subtree trips: **pre** (N-L-R) announces on arrival, **in** (L-N-R) between trips, **post** (L-R-N) on departure.
**Null children are FREE base cases** — every traversal begins `if(!node) return;`. That one line IS the base case discipline.
